Implementation approach: Alice, Eve, Alex: Bob here. We will preserve protocol files exactly and build a clean, deterministic, headless-friendly Snake core in C++17 using CMake. The runtime entry is thin (src/Main.cpp). We separate pure domain entities (Board, Snake) and orchestration (Game) from the RNG boundary (IRandom/DefaultRandom) to keep tests deterministic and portable. Tests include only headers and seed the RNG. We honor strict compilation contracts: include/Types.h is the sole definition site for Position and Direction; any header that mentions either includes "Types.h" directly. include/IRandom.h declares both IRandom and DefaultRandom; src/Random.cpp includes "IRandom.h" exactly. include/IRandom.h directly includes <cstddef>, <cstdint>, and <random>, using std::size_t and std::uint32_t with a std::mt19937 data member. include/Game.h directly includes "Board.h", "IRandom.h", "Snake.h", "Types.h", <cstddef>, <deque>, and <optional>. Direction reversal is prevented; food placement uses the RNG on unoccupied cells; moving into tail is allowed only if not growing. The Game constructor validates dimensions and uses the exact initializer snake_(Position{static_cast<int>(width / 2), static_cast<int>(height / 2)}, Direction::Right, 3). CMake builds a core library from non-Main sources, links runtime and tests to it, calls enable_testing(), and registers the test. Each target_compile_options flag is a separate argument. No GUI or OS-specific behavior; tests run via ctest.

Data structures and interfaces:
classDiagram
    class Position {
        int x
        int y
    }
    class Direction {
        <<enum>> Up
        <<enum>> Down
        <<enum>> Left
        <<enum>> Right
    }
    class IRandom {
        <<interface>>
        +~IRandom()
        +next(maxExclusive: std::size_t) std::size_t
    }
    class DefaultRandom {
        -engine: std::mt19937
        +DefaultRandom(seed: std::uint32_t)
        +next(maxExclusive: std::size_t) std::size_t
    }
    class Board {
        -width_: std::size_t
        -height_: std::size_t
        +Board(width: std::size_t, height: std::size_t)
        +getWidth() std::size_t
        +getHeight() std::size_t
        +inBounds(p: Position) bool
    }
    class Snake {
        -body_: std::deque<Position>
        -dir_: Direction
        +Snake(start: Position, dir: Direction, initialLength: int)
        +head() Position
        +tail() Position
        +body() const std::deque<Position>&
        +direction() Direction
        +trySetDirection(d: Direction) bool
        +advanceTo(next: Position, grow: bool) void
        +occupies(p: Position) bool
    }
    class Game {
        -board_: Board
        -rng_: IRandom&
        -snake_: Snake
        -food_: std::optional<Position>
        -score_: std::size_t
        -gameOver_: bool
        -pendingDir_: std::optional<Direction>
        +Game(width: std::size_t, height: std::size_t, rng: IRandom&)
        +reset() void
        +setDirection(d: Direction) void
        +tick() void
        +isGameOver() bool
        +getScore() std::size_t
        +getSnake() const Snake&
        +getFood() std::optional<Position>
        -placeFood() void
        -wouldSelfCollide(next: Position, grow: bool) const bool
    }

    Game --> Board

Program call flow:
sequenceDiagram
    participant R as runtime (src/Main.cpp)
    participant G as Game
    participant S as Snake
    participant B as Board
    participant RNG as IRandom/DefaultRandom
    R->>RNG: construct(seed)
    R->>G: construct(width,height,RNG)
    G->>B: init bounds
    G->>S: init centered length=3 dir=Right
    G->>G: placeFood()
    loop ticks
        R->>G: setDirection(optional)
        R->>G: tick()
        G->>S: apply pending direction
        G->>S: compute next head
        G->>B: inBounds(next)
        G->>S: wouldSelfCollide(next, grow?)
        alt eating food
            G->>S: advanceTo(next,grow=true)
            G->>G: score++ and placeFood()
        else normal move
            G->>S: advanceTo(next,grow=false)
        end
    end
    R-->>R: print summary and exit
